_: ONE table for the design lifecycle's state rule (docs/hub/design.md, "State -- derived, never stored"), read by both readers of it: Scripts/Read-DesignTree.ps1 Resolve-P20DesignState (tkTestToolkit -Design) and agent/ado/design.py design_state() (Tests/test_design.py). The unit is the design: one id, a note and at most one spec. `note` and `spec` say where each file is -- live (design/ or spec/), archive (design/archive/ or spec/archive/), or null for none -- and noteLines / specLines are footer lines the file carries. expected is the state, the outcome a note archived without a spec may carry (null otherwise), whether the two files disagree about where the design is (mismatch -- the spec's folder wins and the row says so), and the Closed date, a fact about a design that has REACHED an archive state: the spec's for Complete, the note's for Archived, '' for Design and Spec (a note archived before its spec is still a Spec). If the two halves ever disagree about a row, one of them is wrong.

rows.name: a note with its spec beside it
a note archived alone, nothing said of it
the spec archived, the note left behind in design/
the note archived before its spec
a spec standing without a note
an archived spec standing without a note
an idea that never made it
a deck design that shipped as written
an outcome line is a fact about an archived note only: on a live note it is not read
a Complete design needs no outcome: its spec was built, and a stray line is not read
a spec dropped: both archived, the spec carries the dropped outcome, so it reads Archived, not Complete
an outcome word outside the contract's two reads as none
